name: Resonant Authority
author: Simon (simongonzalezdc)
description: Contextual authority for delegated tasks: questions declare dimensions, lanes are weighted by verified outcomes in exactly those dimensions. Non-canonical implementation of the ResonantDAO whitepaper's contribution-weighting idea; the custodian's future spec supersedes this. Self-contained POSIX shell add-on, sideloaded via the current validator; manifest follows the Resonant Extension Framework V0.1 draft fields where compatible.

surfaces.label: Resonant Authority
surfaces.description: Ask who has verified outcomes in the dimensions a question declares; record gated verdicts.

tools.name: resonant_authority.question
tools.description: Rank lanes by weighted accepted-count of verified outcomes in the declared dimensions.

weights.description: optional D=0.7 form, must sum to 1.0

outputSchema.description: ranked lanes with accepted/rejected counts, human class separate

tools.name: resonant_authority.record
tools.description: Append a verified outcome event (date, dimension, lane, verdict accepted|rejected, source pointer).

source.description: path that verbatim contains the verdict
